ui_rules: Existing modern funnel/drawer; revised compact heading data-check badge instead of a full-width notice; pending/all searchable list with public company logo/fallback; horizontal rounded date/status timeline; draft/diff/explicit save protections unchanged
architecture_modules: Pure Prop diagnosis and immutable patch helpers
Shared explicit/implicit pass evidence: evaluation-only funding-derived dates, explicit-event priority, instant exclusion and same-day attempts
api_contracts: Read only cached data during inspection
Update existing own account bought_on/events/update metadata only with stale-snapshot compare and read-back; no full-row upsert or cross-table write
permissions: Owner RLS; no admin private-data access
Read-only or changed owner disables save
operational_constraints: No fabricated or persisted inferred dates, auto-sort/dedupe, generated fees or bulk repair; D5 derives a statistical pass only from an already recorded valid funded date
No production edit/commit/push/real-data test before separate gates
Existing unsupported root data is not replaced silently
data_flows: FLOW-PROP-HISTORY-INSPECT: scoped caches to per-account reasons, all history not financial date
FLOW-PROP-PASS-EVIDENCE: full original history to explicit pass dates or evaluation-only funded-derived pass dates; diagnostic/report/list/company consumers share the same read-only rule
FLOW-PROP-HISTORY-DRAFT: separate purchase date/events with draft removal/restore
FLOW-PROP-HISTORY-SAVE: difference acknowledgement, narrow conditional owner save, conflict/error retention and verified cache/statistics update
